In this work, we use the 770W filter, which is sensitive to 7.7 µm emission from polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) (Smith et al. 2007; Li 2020).

Crucially for this work, the 7.7 µm emission has a strong correlation to the CO (2-1) emission away from star forming regions, allowing us to detect CO streams that go undetected in the CO-ALMA data because they fall below the sensitivity limit of the latter.
